controls.name: Registered recipient
controls.detail: The invoice wallet must match the vendor’s registered wallet.

controls.name: Unique invoice
controls.detail: Same vendor and invoice reference cannot be submitted twice.

controls.name: Payment limit
controls.detail: Amount must fit the vendor’s per-payment limit.

controls.name: Valid destination
controls.detail: A non-zero EVM wallet address is required.
